# Novastaq Technologies Inc

Novastaq Technologies Inc designs, builds, and scales digital products (web and mobile apps, fintech and payment systems, Web3 infrastructure) and supplies phones, laptops, and gadgets to businesses and individuals in Nigeria.

- **Website**: https://novastaq.com
- **Store**: https://store.novastaq.com

- **Headquarters**: Lagos, Nigeria

## What We Do

### 1. Digital Product Development
We engineer custom, scalable software for startups and established enterprises.
- Web & Mobile Applications (React, TypeScript, React Native, Flutter, Go, Python, Laravel)
- Cloud Infrastructure & Scalable Microservices
- Learn more: [Product Development](https://novastaq.com/services/product-development)

### 2. Fintech & Payments
Digital infrastructure powering modern African commerce.
- Payment Gateway Integrations (Paystack, Nomba, Tsara, Flutterwave, Stripe)
- Automated Bank Transfer Reconciliation & Virtual Accounts
- Multi-Currency Wallets and Settlement Systems
- Learn more: [Fintech & Payments](https://novastaq.com/services/fintech)

### 3. Web3 & Blockchain
Secure decentralized systems and tokenized assets.
- Smart Contracts (Solidity, Rust) for EVM & Solana
- Real World Asset (RWA) Tokenization & Custody
- Non-Custodial Wallets and DeFi Protocols
- Learn more: [Web3 Infrastructure](https://novastaq.com/services/web3)

### 4. Tech Procurement & Hardware
Authentic tech devices supplied and delivered across Nigeria.
- Phones: iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel
- Laptops: MacBook, ThinkPad, Dell, HP
- Gadgets & Accessories: Smartwatches, wireless audio, office routers, POS systems
- Learn more: [Tech Procurement](https://novastaq.com/procurement)
